brief_title: Comparison of Two Biphasic Insulin Aspart Treatments in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A Randomised, Double-blind, 4-week, Crossover Trial on Two Treatment Regimens With Biphasic Insulin Aspart 70 and 50 in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: This trial is conducted in Europe. The aim of this trial is to compare two different active treatment regimens of biphasic insulin aspart in subjects with type 2 diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes
* Duration of diabetes for longer than 12 months
* Body mass index (BMI) below 35.0 kg/m\^2
* HbA1c below 11.0 %
* Treatment with BHI (biphasic human insulin) 20 or 30 twice daily for at least three months and in the last month as sole anti-diabetic treatment (i.e., no additional oral hypoglycaemic medication or daily use of short-acting insulin supplement)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current treatment with agents affecting glucose metabolism
* History of drug or alcohol dependence
* Impaired hepatic function
* Impaired renal function
* Cardiac disease
* Proliferative retinopathy
* Recurrent severe hypoglycaemia or advanced neuropathy
